title: Automate SSO authorization for classic PATs and SSH keys
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Enterprise admins can let an enterprise-installed GitHub App authorize existing classic PATs or verified user-owned SSH keys for up to 50 SSO-protected organizations per request, reducing manual credential authorization and rotation friction.
actionable_takeaway: Create an Enterprise Credential Delegation Receipt that records app permission, non-secret credential identifier, target org list, one-hour installation token, skipped orgs, and audit owner.

title: SCIM user responses now include a profileUrl attribute
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub SCIM responses now expose the standard profileUrl attribute when an external identity is linked to a GitHub account, reducing brittle identity matching workarounds.
actionable_takeaway: Add profileUrl to identity reconciliation exports while keeping omitted profileUrl as an explicit unresolved-link state.

title: Copilot budget increase requests are generally available
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Members who exhaust Copilot AI credits can request more budget in-product, and the request routes to the account that pays for the budget.
actionable_takeaway: Build an AI Budget Escalation Queue with task reason, current cap, approved cap, approver, expiration, and post-approval usage review.

title: Code scanning AI Scan no longer requires CodeQL default setup
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: AI Scan for pull requests can run on eligible repositories even when CodeQL default setup is not configured, as long as code scanning and AI Scan are enabled at the proper level.
actionable_takeaway: Recompute AI Scan coverage by enablement and eligibility, not by CodeQL default setup alone.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.86-1 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: Custom agents can opt into repository instruction files through include-custom-instructions, while resume behavior preserves marketplace plugins and skills after reload and sandbox status reports local-network access.
actionable_takeaway: Before enabling instruction inheritance, test AGENTS.md, copilot-instructions.md, and CLAUDE.md precedence, plugin persistence, sandbox local-network reporting, and background shell status.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.85 stable
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The stable release brings Vim mode, context management settings, concise transcript view, /config, sandbox network host rules, and session/memory import commands into one operator surface.
actionable_takeaway: Update the CLI Runtime Receipt to capture editor mode, transcript mode, sandbox network host rules, config screen state, and import/export behavior.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.86-0 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease resumes sessions even when transcript files contain recoverable corruption and stops Autopilot after accepted task completion instead of continuing unexpectedly.
actionable_takeaway: Add corrupted-transcript resume and accepted-completion stop checks to long-running CLI automation smoke tests.

title: OpenAI Node 7.17.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: The Node SDK adds compaction progress events and preserves chat runner abort reasons, making long context and cancellation behavior easier to observe.
actionable_takeaway: Expose compaction progress and abort reason fields in agent run receipts and UI logs before treating context compaction as transparent.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.0-alpha.14 prerelease
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex alpha tags advanced through multiple 0.155.0 alpha releases on September 16, but public release notes remain minimal, so the signal is release-line activity rather than documented feature adoption.
actionable_takeaway: Track Codex alpha tags and asset digests separately from behavior claims; require local smoke evidence before adoption.

title: OpenAI Python 3.14.1
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: The latest Python SDK fixes retry-limit validation, preserves application errors, logs only metadata for Live WebSocket diagnostics, and refreshes streaming examples.
actionable_takeaway: Keep retry boundaries, metadata-only diagnostics, stream reuse, commentary output, and async cleanup in Python SDK upgrade receipts.

title: Authorizing credentials for SSO with a GitHub App
author: GitHub Docs
why_it_matters: The docs define prerequisites, enterprise app ownership, enterprise_credentials write permission, installation access tokens, credential identifiers, and the 50-organization request boundary.
actionable_takeaway: Treat SSO credential authorization as a controlled GitHub App workflow, not as secret sharing or manual PAT handling.

title: AI Scan for pull requests
author: GitHub Docs
why_it_matters: The docs place AI Scan inside GitHub code scanning and PR security workflows, clarifying that eligibility, enablement, and merge protection need to be checked together.
actionable_takeaway: Add AI Scan status to PR security gates alongside code scanning configuration, SARIF, alert tracking, and merge rules.
